tokens.notes: marketing backdrop; app content is full-bleed art so window base bg not independently visible
brand backdrop ONLY — not app chrome
Focus switch track + Active label; app's system-integration accent
segmented 'Videos' selected — NOT accent-tinted; deliberate house rule

tokens.value: full-bleed immersive, traffic lights over content, no standard toolbar

patterns.key_values: ~3-col rounded full-bleed media thumbnails, ~10-12px radius, even ~16px gutters (relative), bottom overlay = source label + like-count; left edge shares hero axis
bottom-right floating capsule control bar (dark translucent): search icon + Images/Videos segmented toggle; floats over content rather than docking
immersive featured hero — full-bleed video wallpaper, bottom gradient scrim carrying eyebrow/title/metadata stack, pagination pill '1/8' bottom-right; interface-disappears chrome

signature_moves: Interface-disappears immersion: wallpaper art is the entire canvas; chrome distilled to one floating capsule + a gradient scrim (Apple TV app's cinematic featured view, applied to a gallery)
White-not-accent selection: neutral white selected segment reserves the accent budget for the art and the single blue system-integration moment
Focus-Mode binding as the product soul: the composited 'Gaming/Active' pill states the thesis — wallpaper follows macOS Focus Mode; the one bold accent moment IS the differentiator
defects: Native-tells deviation (not a taxonomy anti-pattern) — scope switcher in a bottom floating bar instead of the toolbar; systematic + genre-appropriate but lowers native fidelity
Selection not accent-bound — white capsule instead of accent-tinted inset fill (native selection/accent grammar); deliberate house rule, excluded from macOS canon
Contrast Dilution risk (estimated) — dim metadata and dark segmented track over bright/busy art may fall below text 4.5:1 / UI 3:1 in places; unverifiable on a scaled marketing render

aesthetic.direction: Immersive consumer-media gallery (content-art-forward dark) with a Neo-grotesque product surface; marketing layer adds an Editorial/literary serif-italic flourish over a terracotta-into-black gradient
peers: Apple TV app (immersive featured hero + tracked-caps eyebrow)

psychology: Aesthetic-Usability effect — cinematic hero art buys a strong ~50ms first-impression halo, apt for a personalization tool whose entire value is visual
Von Restorff / signal detection — on the dark canvas the single white selected segment and the blue Active switch are the only bright non-art elements; attention lands there
Hick's Law — binary Images/Videos toggle keeps the scope decision minimal
Serial-position (primacy) — one featured hero anchors the top of the browse
Fogg B=MAP (Ability) — marketing 'No sign-up required. Free to try' strips friction at the decision point
Jakob's Law (mild violation) — scope-in-a-bottom-bar defies the trained 'scope lives in the toolbar' expectation
notes: SINGLE marketing composite, no real screenshot: left half is brand evidence (wordmark, serif-italic headline, terracotta gradient, ghost 'Download for free' button); right-half window is genuine app UI but SCALED DOWN, so absolute pt metrics are estimated with wide ranges — trust the proportional/topological readings over the numbers. The 'Gaming/Active' pill is a COMPOSITED stylised system notification (light material over dark window), not a real app element — it illustrates the Focus-Mode hook. Lineage genuinely ambiguous (custom immersive chrome hides AppKit/SwiftUI-vs-Electron tells); recorded native/low, do not feed macOS canon on this evidence. App icon (icon.png) present but NOT digested here (Workflow A only) — for a later Workflow B pass: dark rounded-square ground, a rolled paper/scroll on the left revealing a warm pink->orange->yellow gradient panel (wallpaper roll motif), soft top-lit. Knowledge gaps for this app: no light mode, no settings/empty-state/onboarding surfaces, no real in-app screenshot to verify density, contrast, or true lineage.
